# 24H Virtual — Virtual Receptionist Services

> Professional virtual receptionist and virtual assistant services for businesses across the United States and Canada. Available 24/7/365 with trilingual support (English, Spanish, French).

## Company Overview

24H Virtual provides live and AI-powered call answering, appointment scheduling, message taking, and administrative support for small-to-mid-size businesses. We serve 1,000+ businesses across 15+ industries with over 1 million calls answered. Rated 5.0 stars on Clutch.co.

- Website: https://24hv.io
- Phone: 1-800-825-2587
- Email: hello@24hvirtual.com
- Service Areas: United States & Canada
- Languages: English (24/7), Spanish (8AM–8PM ET), French (8AM–8PM ET)
- HIPAA Compliant: Yes
- Contracts: No long-term contracts required

## Services

### 1. AI Receptionist
AI-powered call answering available 24/7/365. Instant response with zero hold times. Handles unlimited concurrent calls. Best for after-hours, overflow, and routine inquiries.
- Pricing: $49–$2,499/month (50–5,000 minutes)
- Overage: $0.75/minute
- Page: https://24hv.io/solutions/ai-receptionist

### 2. Message Assistant
Professional live message taking service. Captures caller details and delivers messages via email or CRM integration.
- Pricing: $89–$3,499/month (50–5,000 minutes)
- Overage: $1.75/minute
- Page: https://24hv.io/solutions/message-assistant

### 3. Virtual Receptionist
Live US-based receptionists answer calls in your business name. Appointment scheduling, call screening, warm transfers, and custom scripts.
- Pricing: $149–$5,999/month (50–5,000 minutes)
- Overage: $2.00/minute
- Page: https://24hv.io/solutions/virtual-receptionist

### 4. Virtual Secretary
Full administrative support including calendar management, email handling, document preparation, and customer follow-ups.
- Pricing: $199–$7,499/month (50–5,000 minutes)
- Overage: $2.50/minute
- Page: https://24hv.io/solutions/virtual-secretary

### 5. Virtual Assistants (Full-Time)
Dedicated full-time virtual assistants (40 hours/week) for ongoing business support.
- Offshore: $1,899/month (~$14/hr)
- Nearshore (Mexico/Latin America): $2,499/month (~$18/hr)
- Onshore (US/Canada): $4,899/month (~$32/hr)
- Page: https://24hv.io/solutions/virtual-assistants

### 6. Hybrid Receptionist
Combines AI and live receptionist services. AI handles routine calls instantly; human receptionists handle complex conversations with seamless handoff.
- Pricing: Starting at $99/month
- Page: https://24hv.io/solutions/hybrid-receptionist

## Key Differentiators

1. **24/7/365 availability** — Calls answered around the clock, including holidays
2. **Trilingual support** — English, Spanish, and French
3. **No contracts** — Month-to-month plans with no long-term commitment
4. **HIPAA compliant** — Certified for medical, therapy, and healthcare practices
5. **Launch in 24 hours** — Most businesses go live within one business day
6. **US & Canada coverage** — Serves businesses across North America
7. **5.0-star rating** — Verified reviews on Clutch.co
8. **Dynamic billing** — Automatic plan optimization to reduce costs
9. **CRM integrations** — Works with Salesforce, HubSpot, Clio, ServiceTitan, and more
10. **Custom scripts** — Tailored call handling protocols for each business

## How It Works

1. Share your business info and choose a service type
2. Select a plan based on your call volume
3. Customize scripts, greetings, and call handling rules
4. Forward your phone number to our dedicated line
5. Go live — most businesses are answering calls within 24 hours
